author: Disney
description:
Susan Egan, voice of Megara, Hercules (1997) and Tate Donovan, voice of Hercules, Hercules (1997) sit down on stage to chat with Eleni Kontos and Corey Bradford, who originated the roles of Megara and Hercules in Disney Hercules on the Disney Destiny. The four of them discuss what it was like to reimagine a Disney classic and how they brought the original story's magic to the stage.
